verses.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.sm: Afai ou te tautala i gagana a tagata atoa ma agelu, a e leai so‘u alofa, ua avea aʻu ma “apa memea taalili, po o se sumepalo tagitagi.

verses.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.sm: Afai foi o ia te au ona perofeta ane, ma le iloa o mea lilo uma, ma le malamalama uma lava; afai foi o ia te au le faatuatua uma e ave ese ai mauga, a e leai so'u alofa, ou te le aoga lava.

verses.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.sm: Afai foi ou te tufatufaina aʻu mea uma e fagaina a‘i e matitiva; afai foi ou te tuuina atu lo'u tino ina ia susunuina, a e leai so‘u alofa, e leai lava sona aoga ia te au.

verses.en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.sm: E onosai le alofa, e agamalu, e le losilosi le alofa, e le mitamita vale le alofa, e le faafefeteina,

verses.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.sm: e le amio mataga, e le sailia e ia ana lava mea, e le faaitaitagofie, e le faitau leaga ua tuuina mai e nisi,

verses.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verses.sm: e le fiafia i le amio leaga, a E fiafia i le faamaoni.

verses.en: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.sm: O le alofa e lavatia mea uma, e leai se mea e gata maiai lona faatuatua, ma lona faamoemoe ma lona onosai.

verses.en: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.sm: E le uma le alofa; a e pe ni perofetaga, O le a faaleaogaina ia; pe ni gagana, o le a mavae ia; poo le iloa, o le a faaleaogaina lea.

verses.en: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.sm: Aua ua tatou iloa faaleatoa, ma tatou perofeta faaleatoa;

verses.en: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.sm: a e peitai pe a 00 mai le atoatoa, ona faaleaogaina lea o le mea faaleatoa.

verses.en: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.sm: O ona po na ou itiiti ai, na ou tautala ai faatamaitiiti, na ou manatunatu faatamaitiiti, na ou filifili faatamaitiiti; a ua 00 ina ou tagata matua, ona ou tiai lea o mea a tamaiti.

verses.en: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verses.sm: Ana o ona po nei tatou te vaavaai ai faanenefu i le faaata, a o ia ona po tatou te fesagai ai; o nei ona po ou te iloa ai faaleatoa, a o ia ona po ou te iloa tino ai, pei ona iloatinoina o aʻu.

verses.en: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.sm: A o lenei, o tumau le faatuatua, ma le faamoemoe, ma le alofa, o na mea e tolu; a o le sili o na mea o le alofa lea.
